name: Hinge Health Inc.
summary: Established in 2012 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Hinge Health, Inc. creates specialized healthcare software solutions for musculoskeletal and joint health. Their advanced platform is designed to comprehensively manage a spectrum of needs, including general musculoskeletal care, acute injuries, persistent chronic pain, and post-operative rehabilitation. Furthermore, the company provides essential administrative and operational assistance.
